title: MSFS 2024 Marketplace Update (PC): Fly the Iconic 747 KLM + Yosemite & Unique Places!
description:
February 28, 2026 is here, and this week’s MSFS 2024 Marketplace Update brings a seriously must‑have highlight for airliner fans: the iconic 747 KLM mission pack—perfect if you’ve been craving structured, airline-style flying on PC.

🗺️ New activities added this week (PC)
The following activity (missions & miscellaneous) was newly released in the marketplace this week:

🗺️ Perfect Flight: 4AIR MISSIONS – 747 KLM (Airliner-focused missions featuring the legendary KLM 747)
🗺️ Perfect Flight: 8LEGS GRAND TOUR – CARIBBEAN (A multi-leg Caribbean tour built for that “virtual captain” rhythm)
🗺️ Perfect Flight: Above The Sky – Yosemite National Park (Scenic flying vibes—Yosemite never gets old)
🗺️ Koschi: Unique Places – Part 6 (Discovery-style routes to hunt down truly unusual locations)
🗺️ Koschi: Unique Places – Part 7 (Fresh new Unique Places routes—more mysteries to spot from the air)

If you enjoyed the update, hit 👍 like, subscribe for the weekly Marketplace rundown, and drop a comment with which activity you’re flying first (and what aircraft you’re using)!
Thanks for watching, and happy flying everyone 
✈️ See you in the skies!
